-- head/frontend/src/routes/orders/EmptyState.tsx --
export function EmptyState() {
  return (
    <div className="p-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
      No orders yet. New orders appear here as soon as they are placed.
    </div>
  );
}
